newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal says no firms excluded from pulp revamp.
newsitem.headline: Portugal says no firms excluded from pulp revamp.

text.p: Portugal's Economy Ministry said on Wednesday that no company had been excluded from plans to restructure the paper and pulp sector.
The Publico newspaper reported on Wednesday that paper company Inapa would not be part of the reorganisation of the sector.
The ministry mentioned no names but it said that newspaper reports of companies being excluded were incorrect.
"The process of restructuring of the paper and pulp sector will encompass all the companies in the market and their shareholders," it said in a statement.
"The report in the Publico...does not reflect the work in progress nor any hypothetical scenario," it said.

The newspaper said that the government would take a decision by next week on the restructuring which would involve the uniting of Portucel Industrial and Soporcel either through a share swap or by a Portucel buyout.
